Details
  • Paper: MoGe-2: Accurate Monocular Geometry with Metric Scale and Sharp Details, arXiv, 2025-07-03 (for moge-2-vits-normal, moge-2-vitl-normal)
  • Paper: MoGe-3: Fine-Detail Monocular Geometry Estimation with Self-Guided Sparse Volumetric Refinement, arXiv, 2026-07-20 (for moge-3-vitl)
  • Original code: https://github.com/microsoft/MoGe at 74fbce0
  • Code licence: MIT (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: MIT
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/microsoft/MoGe/blob/main/README.md (License section) and the Hugging Face model cards (license: mit)
  • Training data: Mixture of public synthetic and real RGB-D / multi-view datasets per the MoGe-2 and MoGe-3 papers
  • Options: resolution_level = 9 (0 to 9), normals = False
  • Kernel libraries: fastbb, dpt_fused, sparse_conv
  • Variants: moge-2-vits-normal, moge-2-vitb-normal, moge-2-vitl-normal, moge-3-vitl
  • Outputs: depth, points, intrinsics, mask, normals; kind: metric
  • Input size:
    • moge-2-vits-normal, moge-2-vitl-normal, moge-3-vitl: any H x W >= 8, resized or padded inside the model (ViT patch 14)
    • moge-2-vitb-normal: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model (ViT patch 14)
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): moge-2-vits-normal 3000x4000 (1.2 GiB peak allocated, 1.4 reserved); moge-2-vitb-normal 3000x4000 (1.3 GiB peak allocated, 1.4 reserved); moge-2-vitl-normal 3000x4000 (2.4 GiB peak allocated, 2.5 reserved); moge-3-vitl 3000x4000 (2.6 GiB peak allocated, 3.0 reserved)
  • moge-2-vits-normal 994x1482, first call: portable + torch.compile 124 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 131 s (ONNX + engine).
  • moge-2-vitb-normal 994x1482, first call: portable + torch.compile 133 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 127 s (ONNX + engine).
  • moge-2-vitl-normal 994x1482, first call: portable + torch.compile 152 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 173 s (ONNX + engine).
  • moge-2-vits-normal load / first call: original 0.88 s / 1.501 s, portable 0.35 s / 0.084 s, kernels 0.11† s / 0.099 s
  • moge-2-vitb-normal load / first call: original 1.26 s / 0.239 s, portable 0.49 s / 0.397 s (518x770), kernels 1.24 s / 0.285 s (518x770)
  • moge-2-vitl-normal load / first call: original 7.24 s / 0.171 s, portable 1.37 s / 0.144 s, kernels 0.63† s / 0.131 s
  • moge-3-vitl load / first call: original 10.6 s / 2.918 s, portable 1.02 s / 0.562 s, kernels 1.66 s / 0.301 s
  • † measured in the speed sweep after the portable load (or an earlier size) in the same process: file cache and kernels are warm, so the time is lower than a fresh start.
  • Protocol, moge-2-vits-normal, moge-2-vitl-normal: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input (synthetic for bench_inputs sizes), card defaults; gc before each load; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
  • Protocol, moge-2-vitb-normal, moge-3-vitl: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

AbsRel / delta1 after a least-squares scale + shift fit (in disparity space for inverse-depth models), mean over images. Normals: angle to the ground-truth normal over the pixels with ground truth (Marigold's evaluation sets), mean over images. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.
